summary: Kanzhun Ltd submitted a Next Day Disclosure Return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange via Form 6-K, reporting share repurchases. Between March 20 and April 15, 2026, the company repurchased a total of approximately 12.5 million Class A ordinary shares at prices ranging from USD 6.5654 to USD 7.1427 per share. All shares are repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled, representing a return of capital to shareholders. The filing details specific transaction dates, volumes, and prices. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. This reflects a capital return program. Watch for completion of cancellations and further buyback authorization.
